timeline_disposition.reason: Gaṅgeśa is securely placed in Mithilā in the first half of the fourteenth century, with scholarly termini of roughly 1300–1350. That interval spans a politically transitional period in Mithilā, and the evidence reviewed here does not justify assigning his intellectual activity to one exact canonical polity. ATLAS therefore preserves the historical Person without manufacturing a single polity-bound rail.
